propositions: rebar init silently creates an empty orphan branch when fetch of the configured tickets branch fails or times out, instead of failing closed

the current tri-state remote-branch probe (local refs, local remote-tracking ref, or create orphan) conflates genuinely absent branches with unreachable remotes, allowing a timeout to masquerade as first init

a shared bounded git ls-remote advertisement probe must distinguish reachable-advertised, reachable-absent, and unreachable states, cached briefly per repo/remote/branch to limit one timeout per CLI invocation
when the remote is unreachable or times out, explicit init and strict auto-init must fail closed with a distinct diagnostic and never create an orphan unless --force-new-store is supplied
ensure_store_mounted_best_effort must treat unreachable as do-not-auto-mount, return without error, and never supply force_new_store=True
when the remote advertises the branch but fetch fails, init must fail closed with fetch-failure diagnostics and never create an orphan branch
